subject.title: gateway tool not available to external-provider agent sessions

question: Is source inspection plus the reporter's v2026.5.27 Windows/xAI report enough to authorize a fix PR, or should maintainers require a current-main live xAI/Grok reproduction first?
rationale: The source supports the expected allow path but not the reported failure, and changing gateway exposure is security-sensitive because it controls restart/update/config actions.

options.title: Require live repro first
options.body: Keep this issue open for a current-main xAI/Grok `tools.effective` or real session proof before authorizing changes to gateway tool exposure.

options.title: Queue a focused regression-only repair
options.body: Allow a narrow worker to add an xAI/Grok effective-inventory regression and stop if the test cannot reproduce the missing `gateway` tool.

options.title: Treat as already addressed by current policy
options.body: Close only if maintainers can supply a current-main proof showing explicit `alsoAllow` already exposes `gateway` for the reported external-provider session.

recommendation.title: Require live repro first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a current-main xAI/Grok `tools.effective` or real session proof before authorizing changes to gateway tool exposure.
